@font-face{font-family:"LINE Seed Sans TH";src:url("https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68f879d546d2f4e2ab186e90/6a619dd5cdf166a1e9e45b98_LINESeedSansTH_W_XBd.woff2") format("woff2");font-weight:800;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}

/* MMD Wish LV 10. One stylesheet owns the page layout. */
html:has(#mmd-wish){scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px;background:#0b0e10}
body:has(#mmd-wish){background:#0b0e10!important}
#mmd-wish{--ink:#0b0e10;--panel:#171b1d;--raised:#232729;--paper:#f3f0e8;--muted:#bebdb8;--brass:#c9b38a;--line:#3a4040;max-width:none;margin:0;padding:16px 16px 32px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);font-family:'LINE Seed Sans TH',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;isolation:isolate}
#mmd-wish *,#mmd-wish *:before,#mmd-wish *:after{box-sizing:border-box}
#mmd-wish :is(h1,h2,h3,p,figure){margin:0}
#mmd-wish :is(button,input,textarea){font:inherit}
#mmd-wish :is(a,button){touch-action:manipulation}
#mmd-wish :is(a,button,input,textarea,summary):focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:4px}
#mmd-wish :is([hidden],.wish-benefits-v28,.wish-public-consent,.wish-v27-slides,.wish-v27-shade,.wish-v27-dots,.wish-v27-fx){display:none!important}
#mmd-wish>:is(.w-embed){margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
#mmd-wish>:is(section,details){max-width:1180px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
/* Campaign cover */
#mmd-wish .wish-hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--panel)}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-photo{position:relative;order:0;flex:none;width:100%;height:220px;overflow:hidden;background:#101314;isolation:isolate}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:none;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 44%;opacity:0;transition:opacity .85s ease;z-index:1}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-layer.is-active{opacity:1}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(11,14,16,.7),transparent 40%);pointer-events:none}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-glints{display:none}
#mmd-wish .wish-hero__content{position:relative;order:1;min-width:0;padding:22px;background:var(--panel);z-index:3}
#mmd-wish .wish-hero__content>p:first-of-type{color:var(--brass);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;margin:0 0 12px}
#mmd-wish .wish-language{display:flex;gap:3px;position:relative;width:max-content;border:1px solid #59605b;border-radius:24px;padding:3px;margin:0 0 18px;background:var(--ink)}
#mmd-wish .wish-language button{min-width:44px;height:36px;border:0;border-radius:20px;padding:0 12px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
#mmd-wish .wish-language button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--brass);color:var(--ink)}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=hero]{font-family:'Canela',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(43px,12vw,58px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=hero] br{display:initial}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=title]{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin-top:18px;white-space:pre-line}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=lead]{font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;margin-top:10px;color:var(--muted);max-width:45ch}
#mmd-wish :is([data-start],[data-dashboard],.wish-phase2__cta){display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:12px 18px;margin-top:20px;border:1px solid var(--brass);border-radius:7px;background:var(--brass);color:var(--ink);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}
#mmd-wish :is([data-start],[data-dashboard],.wish-phase2__cta):hover{background:#e2d1af}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-caption{display:none}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-rail{position:absolute;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;left:16px;right:76px;bottom:10px;z-index:4}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-rail button{height:44px;min-width:44px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;position:relative;cursor:pointer}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-rail button:after{content:'';position:absolute;top:21px;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:#7e8179}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-rail button.is-active:after{background:var(--paper);height:3px}
#mmd-wish .wish-next-pause{position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:10px;z-index:4;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid #85877e;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(11,14,16,.8);color:var(--paper);cursor:pointer}
#mmd-wish .wish-next-load{position:absolute;right:12px;top:12px;z-index:4;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:#171b1d;color:var(--paper);font-size:11px}
#mmd-wish .wish-next-load progress{width:50px;height:4px;accent-color:var(--brass)}
/* Writing desk */
#mmd-wish #wish-flow{padding:0;margin-top:20px;scroll-margin-top:90px}
#mmd-wish #wish-flow>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel)}
#mmd-wish #wish-flow>div>div:first-child{padding:24px 22px}
#mmd-wish #wish-flow>div>div:first-child>p:first-child{color:var(--brass);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:12px}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=copy]{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:-.02em}
#mmd-wish [data-status]{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;margin-top:14px;color:var(--muted)}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=separation]{padding-top:16px;margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #454b46;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted)}
#mmd-wish .wish-flow__form-shell{margin:0;min-width:0;background:var(--paper)}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-form]{display:block;position:relative;padding:24px 20px;background:var(--paper);color:#232729}
#mmd-wish [aria-label='ตัวช่วยเขียน']{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:20px}
#mmd-wish [data-prompt]{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:7px 11px;border:1px solid #b5b6ab;border-radius:5px;background:#faf8f1;color:#363c37;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
#mmd-wish [data-prompt]:hover{border-color:#78613a;background:#e8dfcd}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-form]>label{display:block;position:relative;margin:0;font-weight:400}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=label]{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:9px}
#mmd-wish [data-message]{display:block;resize:vertical;width:100%;min-height:164px;max-height:360px;margin:0;padding:14px 14px 32px;border:1px solid #92978b;border-radius:7px;background:#fffdf8;color:#232729;font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;box-shadow:none}
#mmd-wish [data-message]::placeholder{color:#697063;opacity:1;-webkit-text-fill-color:#697063}
#mmd-wish [data-message]:focus{border-color:#79613b}
#mmd-wish [data-count]{display:block;position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:8px;color:#62695e;font-size:11px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-form]>label:has([data-consent]){display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-form]>label:has([data-consent])>.w-checkbox{flex:0 0 22px;min-width:22px;margin:0;padding:0}
#mmd-wish [data-consent]{float:none;width:22px;height:22px;margin:3px 0 0;accent-color:#685335;cursor:pointer}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-form]>label:has([data-consent])>span:empty{display:none}
#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=consent]{flex:1;min-width:0;font-style:normal;font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:#363c37}
#mmd-wish [data-submit]{display:block;width:100%;min-height:50px;margin-top:18px;padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid #171b1d;border-radius:7px;background:#171b1d;color:var(--paper);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
#mmd-wish [data-submit]:disabled{border-color:#d7d9cf;background:#d7d9cf;color:#60665a;cursor:not-allowed}
#mmd-wish [data-message]:disabled{opacity:.72}
#mmd-wish [data-error]{margin-top:12px;color:#8e3027;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
#mmd-wish [data-error]:empty{display:none}
#mmd-wish [data-success]{position:relative;margin-top:20px;padding:26px 22px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--brass);border-radius:16px}
#mmd-wish [data-success]>p:first-child{color:var(--brass);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em}
#mmd-wish [data-success] h2{font-size:32px;line-height:1.3;margin:12px 0}
#mmd-wish [data-success-copy]{font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted)}
/* Eligibility, all details remain accessible. */
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2{margin-top:24px;border-block:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 0}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__visual{display:none;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel)}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__visual img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__copy{min-width:0}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__copy>p:first-child{color:var(--brass);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:12px}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__copy h2{font-size:26px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.025em;white-space:pre-line}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__lead{margin-top:12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.8}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__reward{margin-top:18px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #4d5148;border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel)}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__reward :is(small,strong,span){display:block}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__reward small{font-size:11px;color:var(--brass)}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__reward strong{font-size:23px;line-height:1.45;margin:6px 0}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__reward span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__fine{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__cta{background:transparent;color:var(--paper);border-color:#6c7063;margin-top:12px;justify-content:center}
#mmd-wish .wish-phase2__cta:hover{background:var(--raised)}
#mmd-wish #mmd-careback-benefits-v29{margin-top:16px;margin-bottom:0}
#mmd-wish #mmd-careback-benefits-v29 [data-cb-open]{border-radius:7px;font-size:14px;min-height:48px}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-ribbon{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:24px}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-ribbon article{padding-left:17px;border-left:1px solid #5d635b}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-ribbon small{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--brass)}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-ribbon strong{display:block;font-size:15px;margin:4px 0}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-ribbon p{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-policy{margin-top:24px;padding:16px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel)}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-policy summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;min-height:30px;font-size:14px}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-policy__body{padding-top:16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.8}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-policy__grid{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-policy__grid strong{display:block;color:var(--brass);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em}
/* Only backend-approved wishes enter the wall. */
#mmd-wish .wish-member-wall{margin-top:28px;padding:24px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
#mmd-wish .wish-member-wall h2{font-size:24px;line-height:1.4}
#mmd-wish .wish-member-wall p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;margin-top:8px;color:var(--muted)}
#mmd-wish .wish-member-wall-list{display:grid;gap:10px;max-height:340px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;margin-top:18px;scrollbar-width:thin}
#mmd-wish .wish-member-wall blockquote{margin:0;padding:18px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--paper)}
#mmd-wish .wish-member-wall button{min-height:44px;margin-top:14px;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid #72776b;border-radius:6px;color:var(--paper);background:transparent;cursor:pointer}
#mmd-wish .wish-v23-reveal{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none}
/* Memories are a short closing section, not another full-page hero. */
body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1{background:#171b1d;color:#f3f0e8;padding:30px 16px;border-top:1px solid #3a4040;font-family:'LINE Seed Sans TH',Arial,sans-serif}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1 *{box-sizing:border-box}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .bkkv1-shell{max-width:1180px;margin:auto}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .bkkv1-k{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#c9b38a}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1 h2{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:26px;line-height:1.4;max-width:24ch;color:#f3f0e8}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1 p{max-width:62ch;color:#bebdb8;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;margin:12px 0 0}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .bkkv1-rail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:22px}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1 figure{position:relative;min-width:0;aspect-ratio:1;margin:0;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:#232729}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1 img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1 figcaption{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;padding:20px 10px 8px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#0b0e10);color:#f3f0e8;font-size:9px;line-height:1.4}
body:has(#mmd-wish) .bkkv1-swipe{display:none}
@media(min-width:768px){
 #mmd-wish{padding:28px 28px 48px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.94fr);grid-template-areas:'copy photo';min-height:500px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-v23-photo{grid-area:photo;height:100%;min-height:500px;order:initial;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
 #mmd-wish .wish-hero__content{grid-area:copy;order:initial;padding:38px 40px;align-self:center}
 #mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=hero]{font-size:clamp(54px,5vw,76px);max-width:8ch}
 #mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=hero] br{display:initial}
 #mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=title]{font-size:28px;margin-top:22px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-language{margin-bottom:22px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-v23-caption{display:block;position:absolute;top:20px;left:20px;z-index:3;color:var(--paper);padding:10px 12px;border-left:1px solid var(--brass);background:rgba(11,14,16,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
 #mmd-wish .wish-v23-caption small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--brass)}
 #mmd-wish .wish-v23-caption strong{display:block;font-family:'Canela',Georgia,serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.1;margin-top:6px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-v23-caption p{font-size:8px;margin-top:8px}
 #mmd-wish #wish-flow{margin-top:28px}
 #mmd-wish #wish-flow>div{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr)}
 #mmd-wish #wish-flow>div>div:first-child{padding:36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
 #mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=copy]{font-size:28px}
 #mmd-wish [data-wish-form]{padding:32px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-phase2{padding:30px 0;margin-top:30px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-phase2__shell{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.72fr) minmax(0,1.28fr);gap:32px;align-items:center}
 #mmd-wish .wish-phase2__visual{display:block;aspect-ratio:1;max-height:420px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-phase2__copy h2{font-size:30px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-v23-ribbon{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px}
 #mmd-wish .wish-v23-policy__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 #mmd-wish .wish-member-wall-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
 body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1{padding:40px 28px}
 body:has(#mmd-wish) .bkkv1-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 40px;align-content:center}
 body:has(#mmd-wish) .bkkv1-rail{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/4;margin:0}
 body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1 h2{font-size:28px}
}
@media(max-width:359px){#mmd-wish{padding:10px}#mmd-wish .wish-hero__content{padding:18px}#mmd-wish [data-wish-copy=hero]{font-size:40px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html:has(#mmd-wish){scroll-behavior:auto}#mmd-wish *,body:has(#mmd-wish) .mmd-bkkv1 *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}
/* Explicit text colors protect against global gradient text rules. */
#mmd-wish :is([data-wish-copy=hero],[data-wish-copy=title],[data-wish-copy=copy],.wish-phase2__copy h2,.wish-phase2__reward strong,[data-success] h2,.wish-member-wall h2,.wish-v23-ribbon strong){color:#f3f0e8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f3f0e8!important;background-image:none!important}
#mmd-wish :is([data-wish-copy=lead],[data-status],[data-wish-copy=separation],.wish-phase2__lead,.wish-phase2__fine,[data-success-copy]){color:#bebdb8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bebdb8!important}
#mmd-wish :is([data-start],[data-dashboard]){color:#0b0e10!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#0b0e10!important}
#mmd-wish :is([data-message],[data-wish-copy=label],[data-wish-copy=consent],[data-prompt],[data-prompt] *){color:#363c37!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#363c37!important}
#mmd-wish [data-submit]{color:#f3f0e8!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#f3f0e8!important}
#mmd-wish [data-submit]:disabled{color:#60665a!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#60665a!important}
#mmd-wish [data-error]{color:#8e3027!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#8e3027!important}
#mmd-wish [data-count]{color:#62695e!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#62695e!important}
</style>
